values.meaning: Ability lockout after casting Breath of Life
values.quote: cannot cast his other abilities for {{fd|0.75}} seconds after Breath of Life's activation
values.binNote: wiki-only value; no matching bin data value found (castTime field is 0.713, a different number for the cast animation, not this lockout).

mechanics.claim: Breath of Life heals and cleanses himself and nearby allied champions of non-airborne crowd control.
mechanics.quote: '''Milio''' explodes in soothing flames, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself and nearby allied champions of non-{{tip|airborne}} {{tip|crowd control}}, and granting them 65% {{tip|tenacity}} for 3 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Milio cannot cast his other abilities for a short time after activating this ability.
mechanics.quote: '''Milio''' cannot cast his other abilities for {{fd|0.75}} seconds after Breath of Life's activation

mechanics.claim: Breath of Life cannot be cast while Milio is under cast-inhibiting crowd control.
mechanics.quote: Breath of Life cannot be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
